say:1:1711105001:1.text: Ah, are you here looking for King Rolan too?
say:1:1711105001:1.source_cn: 啊……你也是罗兰大帝的追随者吗？
say:1:1711105001:1.male: Ah, are you here looking for King Rolan too?
say:1:1711105001:1.female: Ah, are you here looking for King Rolan too?

say:3:1711105002:0.text: Then what are you doing here? Hmph. I'll be keeping an eye on you.
say:3:1711105002:0.source_cn: 那你的目的是什么？我可要仔细看着点你！
say:3:1711105002:0.male: Then what are you doing here? Hmph. I'll be keeping an eye on you.
say:3:1711105002:0.female: Then what are you doing here? Hmph. I'll be keeping an eye on you.

say:4:1711105005:1.text: Anyway, there have been far too many people trying to see him lately so he hasn't shown himself in ages.
say:4:1711105005:1.source_cn: 虽说如此，前来朝拜罗兰大帝的人太多，他已经很长时间没有...
say:4:1711105005:1.male: Anyway, there have been far too many people trying to see him lately so he hasn't shown himself in ages.
say:4:1711105005:1.female: Anyway, there have been far too many people trying to see him lately so he hasn't shown himself in ages.

say:5:1711105006:1.text: A legendary figure like him must have used that cute fox form as a disguise to avoid being disturbed.
say:5:1711105006:1.source_cn: 那位大人物一定是不想被打扰，才选择伪装成可爱的狐狸隐藏...
say:5:1711105006:1.male: A legendary figure like him must have used that cute fox form as a disguise to avoid being disturbed.
say:5:1711105006:1.female: A legendary figure like him must have used that cute fox form as a disguise to avoid being disturbed.

say:6:1711105007:1.text: But nobody understands that! They keep bothering him!
say:6:1711105007:1.source_cn: 可是大家不懂这个道理，总是来烦他！
say:6:1711105007:1.male: But nobody understands that! They keep bothering him!
say:6:1711105007:1.female: But nobody understands that! They keep bothering him!

say:7:1711105008:1.text: Though... I can't really blame them. I'd love to see him in person too. They say he's breathtakingly handsome...
say:7:1711105008:1.source_cn: 虽然我也很想一睹真容，听说是个非常俊美的男子……
say:7:1711105008:1.male: Though... I can't really blame them. I'd love to see him in person too. They say he's breathtakingly handsome...
say:7:1711105008:1.female: Though... I can't really blame them. I'd love to see him in person too. They say he's breathtakingly handsome...

say:8:1711105009:1.text: Ahh! What if I see him and he ruins all other men for me forever?! What am I supposed to do then?!
say:8:1711105009:1.source_cn: 啊啊啊！万一见了他以后，再也看不上其他男人呢？这可怎么...

say:10:1711105003:1.text: Really?! Me too! Though I only started following him recently, so I'm still nowhere near a proper devotee...
say:10:1711105003:1.source_cn: 我也是，不过我是最近才开始追随的，忠诚度不够高！
say:10:1711105003:1.male: Really?! Me too! Though I only started following him recently, so I'm still nowhere near a proper devotee...
say:10:1711105003:1.female: Really?! Me too! Though I only started following him recently, so I'm still nowhere near a proper devotee...

say:11:1711105004:1.text: Show some respect! That's King Rolan to you! Though, I have to admit, "little fox" does sound pretty adorable...
say:11:1711105004:1.source_cn: 要尊称罗兰大帝，虽然小狐狸的称呼意外地有点可爱……
